newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel South Lebanon post damaged in shelling.
newsitem.headline: Israel South Lebanon post damaged in shelling.

text.p: Lebanese guerrillas rained mortar bombs and anti-tank missiles on an Israeli army garrison in south Lebanon on Monday, causing damage but no casualties, the army said.

"Anti-tank missiles and mortar shells were fired this morning towards army posts in the eastern sector of the south Lebanon security zone. There were no injuries but damage was caused to one of the posts," a communique said.
The army said it returned fire towards the sources of the shelling and that Lebanese Hizbollah guerrillas claimed responsibility for the attack.

Iranian-backed Hizbollah (Party of God) forces are fighting to oust Israeli troops and their Lebanese Christian militia allies from the 15 km (nine-mile) wide border zone set up by the Israel after it withdrew the bulk of a 1982 invasion force.
